AboutIntro.title: Built on Precision. Grown on Trust.
AboutIntro.body: Arabian Solutions Beacon Est. was founded in Riyadh with a singular commitment: deliver world-class industrial contracting services through two specialized divisions — a precision welding and machining workshop, and a field operations arm covering pumping systems, electromechanical installations, and structural fabrication. Our specialized technical team operates with military-grade precision across Saudi Arabia’s most demanding infrastructure environments — from deep-well pump installations at 460m depth to curtain wall systems at Lulu Hypermarket Riyadh.
AboutIntro.quote: “Aspire to be the pioneer in providing best-in-class welding services and a recognized contributor to the Kingdom's growth.”

QualityStandards.title: Quality is Not an Option. It's Our Architecture.
QualityStandards.qualityManagementSummary: ASBC's welding quality management system covers pre-weld, in-process, and post-weld inspection — including WPS/PQR approval, Welders Performance Tests, DP Testing (100% root + final), Radiographic Examination (10% weld joints), Pickling & Passivation, and Final Dimensional Inspection. Materials tested to ASME IX / ASTM A312 / A182 standards.
